g.text: Cloud control plane (Cloudflare, same pattern as CRM, TBD)
Dev boxes via Orca (e.g. Fly Sprites, elastic, capped)
Scheduler + runtime pool (per-host caps, dev-box caps, placement rules)
must claim a work item to write)
orca: start session on dev box
orca CLI (worktree, start agent, send, wait)
MCP: create/claim work item, lease, stage, handoff
required factory/verify check on every PR
